tools.name: check_post_quantum_tls
tools.description: Does this public hostname negotiate hybrid post-quantum key exchange (X25519MLKEM768)? Returns TLS version, hybrid yes/no and a one-line verdict. Free. One TLS handshake per probe, no scanning.

tools.name: check_tls_certificate
tools.description: Certificate issuer, expiry date, days left, and whether the chain verifies for the hostname from a strict client (catches missing intermediate certificates and name mismatches). Free.

tools.name: audit_wazuh_rules
tools.description: Finds Wazuh custom rules that pass wazuh-analysisd -t but are dropped at load (load order across ruleset/rules and etc/rules, missing parents, duplicate or colliding ids). Input: list of {filename, xml}. Supported versions: 4.14.7, 4.14.9. Free: counts + 2 findings. Full report: pass api_key.

tools.name: test_wazuh_rule
tools.description: Runs log lines through a real wazuh-manager 4.14.9 (fresh logtest session) with your custom rules and decoders: which decoder and rule matched, whether YOUR rule fired, and load warnings such as 7617/7619. Logtest engine: frequency/timeframe rules and some live-only behaviour are out of scope. Free:

tools.name: check_php2shell
tools.description: Is this PHP install exposed to PHP2Shell, the two critical unauthenticated RCE flaws patched on 21 Oct 2026 (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619)? Paste local evidence collected on the server: `php -v`, `php -i` or `php-fpm -i`, `cat /etc/os-release`, `dpkg -l 'php*'` or `rpm -qa 'php*'`. Returns patch

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "audit_wazuh_rules" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_post_quantum_tls, test_wazuh_rule · Private data: test_wazuh_rule · Public sink: check_post_quantum_tls, test_wazuh_rule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_post_quantum_tls, test_wazuh_rule · Private data: test_wazuh_rule · Public sink: check_post_quantum_tls, test_wazuh_rule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
